title: INBOTICS 2026: 5-Day Hands-on Robotics Workshop
description: A 5-day immersive, practical workshop designed to take you from the fundamentals of electronics and microcontrollers to deploying code on real hardware. Build your own bot from scratch!
longDescription: Ever wondered how robots actually work and how code brings machines to life? Here’s your chance to find out! The Robotics Club brings you INBOTICS 2026—a 5-day immersive, practical workshop designed to take you from the fundamentals of electronics and microcontrollers to deploying code on real hardware. Skip the boring theory and dive straight into building your own functioning robot with direct mentorship!
rules: 5 days of comprehensive, practical, hands-on learning.
Zero prerequisites: No prior coding, electronics, or robotics experience required.
Build your own bot from the ground up with guided club mentorship.
Free takeaway robotics kit worth ₹3,000 for participants.
Official participation certificate awarded to every attendee.
Top performers earn the opportunity to represent the university at a national-level tech fest.
Complete your registration via the official Google Form link before slots fill up.
